name: Parameter Remocon
original_name: パラメータ・リモコン
source:
Kotaro Etozawa has obtained a remote control for "affection".
When he uses it, it dials up a girl's desire for a boy. Easy to use, instant results.
It works handily on a classmate, the nurse, and his hot teacher...
Taking his pleasure, the story progresses...

This is a visual novel adaptation of a poplular web novel and covers the first eleven chapters of it.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE164241.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
江泽幸太得到了一只能够控制“好感度”的遥控器。

使用遥控器后，他可以提高女孩对某个男孩的欲望。操作简单，立即见效。

同班同学、护士，还有性感的女教师，都能成为它的对象……

享受快乐的同时，故事不断发展……

本作改编自一部人气网络小说，收录了原作前11章内容。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE164241.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
